patterns: PYQs are term-to-meaning items: Bhaga/Bali = revenue, Udakabhaga = irrigation tax, kulyavapa/dronavapa = land measures, vishti = forced labour as a tax, land revenue = one-sixth.
Unit hierarchy (Bhukti > Vishaya > Vithi > Grama) and town-board members (Kayastha = scribes, APPSC G2) are recurring.
UPSC adds conceptual statement items (essential elements of feudalism: land-based administration + lord-vassal, not a strong centre).
Tax-free land to Brahmins (brahmadeya/agrahara) is the stock grant question; distractors are officials and scholars.
App covers PYQ facts well but adds deep historiography (Sircar, Mukhia, Chattopadhyaya) and rare tenure terms that APPSC has not asked.
